name: The Fate of a Loved One

faq.answer: Resaan returned to the Ruins of Ban'aethal to gather supplies despite his partner's pleas that he stay. More than a week has passed without word, and his partner fears the worst.
The Ruins of Ban'aethal are where Resaan went in search of supplies. His partner fears he may not have survived a week there alone.
faq.q: What are the Ruins of Ban'aethal?

faq.answer: Resaan returned to Ban'aethal to retrieve supplies despite his partner's pleas that he stay.
faq.q: Why did Resaan return to Ban'aethal?

faq.answer: Resaan's partner asks travelers to bring him safely home if he is alive. If he has perished in the ruins, they ask for his personal heirloom as a keepsake.
faq.q: What does the questgiver ask you to bring back?

aliases: how long has resaan been gone
faq.answer: Resaan has been missing for more than a week since setting out for the Ruins of Ban'aethal. The dangers there leave his partner fearing the worst.
faq.q: How long has Resaan been missing?

aliases: who gives fate of a loved one
fate of a loved one questgiver
faq.answer: Resaan's grieving partner asks passing travelers heading toward Ban'aethal for help, desperate to learn what became of him.

keywords: the fate of a loved one

sections.body: Resaan's partner pleads with him to stay as he prepares to return to the Ruins of Ban'aethal. Yet he feels compelled to brave the ruins for supplies. His partner is left waiting for word.
sections.title: A Desperate Plea

sections.body: More than a week has passed since Resaan set out, far longer than a swift return should take. His partner asks travelers bound for Ban'aethal to search the ruins. If Resaan lives, bring him home. If tragedy has taken him, recover his family heirloom.
sections.title: Vanished in the Ruins

summary: Resaan has been gone from the Ruins of Ban'aethal for more than a week, and his partner waits for news. Travelers bound there are asked to bring him home or return his cherished heirloom.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Fate of a Loved One
